measure: elapsed seconds of each target in the receipt, multiplied by the worker processes it ran with (11 xdist workers for test-server and test-naapp-lib, 1 otherwise): an upper bound on its CPU-seconds, used as relative weights. The receipt has no per-container CPU accounting. A lane's work is the sum of its targets. Integration was stopped at 2209 s after unit's red; its figure sums the targets it completed, a lower bound.
